item.title: Computer Applications Frontiers: Opportunities, Challenges, Technologies and Applications
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores emerging frontiers in computer applications, examining new opportunities and challenges in the field. The call invites research on innovative technologies and practical applications that advance the landscape of computer science and its real-world implementations.
